say:1:1110123001:0.text: Are you looking for food? There's not much, but don't worry!
say:1:1110123001:0.source_cn: 你们是在找食物吗？食物不太多了……不过别担心！

say:2:1110123002:0.text: I heard Alsa brought back a tasty wild sandbeast!
say:2:1110123002:0.source_cn: 听说阿尔萨今天带了好吃的回来！似乎是野猪呢！

say:3:1110123003:0.text: We just have to be patient. Soren is cooking it now.
say:3:1110123003:0.source_cn: 客人可以稍等会，索恩已经去料理了。

choice_prompt:4:1110123003.text: We just have to be patient. Soren is cooking it now.
choice_prompt:4:1110123003.source_cn: 客人可以稍等会，索恩已经去料理了。

say:5:1110123004:0.text: There's definitely enough today. Since you're our guests, you get the haunch. We'll split the other parts after.
say:5:1110123004:0.source_cn: 今天肯定是够的，肉排给客人之后，其他的部位我们就能分着吃了。
say:5:1110123004:0.male: There's definitely enough today. Since you're our guests, you get the haunch. We'll split the other parts after.
say:5:1110123004:0.female: There's definitely enough today. Since you're our guests, you get the haunch. We'll split the other parts after.

say:6:1110123005:0.text: Normally, we don't get meat, but we always have something to eat.
say:6:1110123005:0.source_cn: 平常的话，虽然没有太多肉，但填肚子倒是没什么问题呢。
say:6:1110123005:0.male: Normally, we don't get meat, but we always have something to eat.
say:6:1110123005:0.female: Normally, we don't get meat, but we always have something to eat.
